Skate 3 Map to Unreal
=====================

1. Double-click SkateMapToUnreal.exe
2. Select your Xbox 360 Skate 3 ISO
3. Click Extract ISO  (downloads extract-xiso automatically)
4. Pick a map, set output folders, Convert
5. In Unreal: Tools -> Execute Python Script -> import_to_unreal.py

Requirements on the PC:
  - Windows 10/11 64-bit
  - Git for Windows  (first map convert clones the engine)
  - Internet  (first run downloads extract-xiso + clones engine)

Runtime data is stored in the "runtime" folder next to this exe.
